candidate.head: 5980890c47f973b50fc677a962242e893e96f001
candidate.note: The candidate is main's exact tree: S09 added no product, renderer, asset or test byte. Any failure below therefore exists on main; the classification separates real defects from defects in my instruments.

instruments.why: attributable verdict per module; tests/test_weapon_sfx.py sets SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy at import, process-wide, which poisons later GL modules in one process
instruments.protection: native sandbox-exec write-deny over the live checkout and installed user data for the whole descendant tree; canary sentinel unchanged; independent before/after user-data inventory identical
instruments.pytest_and_script_fallback: test_classic_screens and test_menu_movie are pytest-authored; test_classic_replays_gl is a main() script printing CLASSIC_REPLAYS_GL_OK - no module was counted as a pass for yielding zero tests

instruments.why: the literal whole-tree command, kept because it is what a reviewer will run
instruments.verdict: NOT usable as the attributable instrument: 10 of its 12 non-ok results are defects in the launcher, see instrument_defects

instruments.why: executed control on the same bytes for every non-ok result of both protected runs
instruments.verdict: 12 of 14 pass unprotected; the 2 that still fail are reproduced on the same bytes

protection_self_test.violations_kind: 3 deliberate denials exercised by the self-test itself, not suite writes

test_gl_lifecycle.MainLifecycleTests.tes.detail: AttributeError: 'types.SimpleNamespace' object has no attribute 'ds' at main.py:293 configure_from_settings(SETTINGS, data_store=gm.ds)
test_gl_lifecycle.MainLifecycleTests.tes.introduced_by: S08 commit e82345f added data_store=gm.ds to main.start_game; the AST-extracted fixture in tests/test_gl_lifecycle.py (last touched in df78eb7, #111) builds a make_game namespace with state and mission but no ds
test_gl_lifecycle.MainLifecycleTests.tes.why_s08_missed_it: S08's own gate ran 18 selected modules; test_gl_lifecycle was not among them, and S08 never ran the whole suite (its handoff says so)
test_gl_lifecycle.MainLifecycleTests.tes.handling: carried as a recorded pre-existing failure. The repair is one line in the fixture (add ds to the fake game namespace); it is test-only and does not weaken the assertion, but it changes a test byte, so it is proposed as its own small change rather than folded into the acceptance receipt

test_crew_recovery_ui.RecoveryUITests.te.detail: AssertionError: 'imperial:convoy' != 'box' - the guard still expects the legacy box fallback for the Imperial crew transport
test_crew_recovery_ui.RecoveryUITests.te.handling: unchanged from S07: carried, not repaired inside an unrelated increment

instrument_defects.mechanism: the launcher rewrites every child launched with sys.executable into itself (--python-child); that re-entry imports pygame, whose greeting lands on the child's stdout, so a tool's JSON/output no longer starts at column 1
instrument_defects.control: both pass unprotected on the same bytes

instrument_defects.mechanism: same rewrite injects sys.path into a child whose contract is to run with no PYTHONPATH
the launcher's audit barrier calls Path.resolve() on the path being written, and these fixtures deliberately create symlink loops; resolve() raises RuntimeError, which escapes as a test error
instrument_defects.control: both pass unprotected on the same bytes

instrument_defects.mechanism: setUp fails with 'Could not allocate fleet shader' only in the single-process run; the module passes in a fresh process under the same sandbox, so this is single-process GL state, not the barrier
instrument_defects.control: pass in the per-module gate and unprotected

not_executed: A pristine `git archive` control of the two failing modules: the command was blocked awaiting consent and was not run. The byte-identity above (candidate tree == origin/main tree) plus the executed unprotected control on the same bytes carries the same conclusion.
test_frozen_paths in a real checkout: it skips in a linked worktree because .git is a file. Not re-run in a checkout; recorded as outstanding, not as a pass.
gate_status: S09 is NOT accepted. Suite classification is done; owner performance targets/resolution, native-platform evidence or an explicit waiver, and exact-candidate frozen packages remain open.
